content.introduction: The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) releases the "Real Earnings" data for September 2026 on October 02, 2026, at 08:30 AM. The Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA) releases its statistics publication schedule for 2026, with the first release on August 18, 2026, and subsequent releases on September 15, October 16, November 17, and December 15, 2026. The sources do not provide a definitive answer for the exact release schedule of "Real Earnings" beyond September 2026.
